purpose: Protocol for the one-time final draw.io RAG comparison. Expected answers and task payloads must not be committed to this repository before release.
releaseRequirements: An independent owner stores the payload outside the development repository.
Baseline and final candidate commits, task fixture hash, evaluator hash and model manifest are frozen before release.
The payload is used once for the final paired comparison and is not used for further tuning.
Only the released payload hash and final aggregate result are committed afterward.
legacyHoldoutDisposition: Repository-visible v1 holdout tasks and the 100 core holdout cases remain historical evaluation fixtures, but are not claimed as unseen final holdout data.
